Course notebooks will provide executable demonstrations and exercises for
numerical matrix computation, exact symbolic computation, visualization, and
experimentation.

::: {.callout-note}
## Content in development

Notebook links will be added only after each notebook has been developed and
validated. The introductory notebook is still a structural placeholder.
:::

## Demonstrations

Instructor demonstrations will illustrate linear algebra concepts and connect
algebraic calculations with geometric interpretation. Validated notebook links
will appear here.

## Exercises

Student exercises will provide opportunities to explore matrices, vector
spaces, transformations, eigenvalues, and inner products computationally.
Validated notebook links will appear here.
